_note: Strings used only by the web demo (not in the app's content packs). Swahili here is a draft and needs native-speaker review.

en.web.demo_note: This is the web demo of Mavuno, an offline Android app for smallholder coffee farmers in Kenya. The same leaf model and the same scoring table run here, in your browser. Nothing you add leaves this page.
en.web.model_ready: Leaf model {version} is running in your browser
en.web.model_error: The leaf model could not load in this browser, so photos cannot be read. You can still answer the questions and see how the scoring works.
en.web.not_counted_hint: Below {pct}% sure, or not a coffee leaf
en.web.plot_note: The app looks these up offline from a regional rain and soil pack for the farmer's plot. In this web demo you enter them by hand.
en.web.how_decided_note: Every cause starts at its prior. Each thing the app knows adds or takes away points. Points become chances with a softmax. These weights are expert placeholders, not fitted to data.
en.web.best_guesses: Best guesses kept for the extension officer
en.web.credits: Leaf photos and training data: JMuBEN, JMuBEN2, BRACOL and PlantDoc datasets, CC BY 4.0. Sample leaves on this page are from BRACOL and JMuBEN (CC BY 4.0).
en.web.disclaimer: Not reviewed by an agronomist. Do not use for real decisions.

sw.web.demo_note: Hili ni toleo la wavuti la Mavuno, programu ya Android isiyohitaji mtandao kwa wakulima wadogo wa kahawa nchini Kenya. Modeli ileile ya majani na jedwali lilelile la alama vinafanya kazi hapa, kwenye kivinjari chako. Hakuna unachoongeza kinachotoka kwenye ukurasa huu.
sw.web.model_ready: Modeli ya majani {version} inafanya kazi kwenye kivinjari chako
sw.web.model_error: Modeli ya majani haikuweza kupakia kwenye kivinjari hiki, kwa hivyo picha haziwezi kusomwa. Bado unaweza kujibu maswali na kuona jinsi alama zinavyofanya kazi.
sw.web.not_counted_hint: Uhakika chini ya {pct}%, au si jani la kahawa
sw.web.plot_note: Programu huyatafuta haya bila mtandao kutoka kwenye kifurushi cha mvua na udongo cha eneo la shamba. Katika toleo hili la wavuti unayaingiza mwenyewe.
sw.web.how_decided_note: Kila chanzo kinaanza na alama yake ya awali. Kila kitu programu inachojua kinaongeza au kupunguza alama. Alama zinageuzwa kuwa nafasi kwa softmax. Uzito huu ni wa muda kutoka kwa wataalamu, haujapimwa kwa data.
sw.web.best_guesses: Makisio bora yaliyohifadhiwa kwa afisa ugani
sw.web.credits: Picha za majani na data ya mafunzo: JMuBEN, JMuBEN2, BRACOL na PlantDoc, CC BY 4.0. Majani ya mfano kwenye ukurasa huu ni kutoka BRACOL na JMuBEN (CC BY 4.0).
sw.web.disclaimer: Haijakaguliwa na mtaalamu wa kilimo. Usitumie kwa maamuzi halisi.
